description: opencc-fmmseg C API .NET interop library for Chinese text conversion between Traditional and Simplified Chinese
releaseNotes:
v1.5.0

            New Features:
            - Added four Small Seal Script conversion configurations: s2seal, t2seal, seal2s, and seal2t (IDs 21-24).
            - Added Small Seal Script support to both typed OpenccConfig and string-based conversion APIs.
            - Added CustomDictSpec, DictSlot, and CustomDictMode for strongly typed custom dictionary configuration.
            - Added a new OpenccFmmseg constructor accepting multiple ordered custom dictionary specifications.
            - Added Append and Override modes for extending or replacing individual native dictionary slots.
            - Added support for all 25 native dictionary slots, including four Small Seal Script slots.
            - Added NormalizeCompat() for standard CJK Compatibility Ideograph normalization.
            - Added NormalizeCompatExtended() for extended CJK compatibility normalization.
            - Added DeTofu() with a strongly typed DeTofuLevel enum and inclusive fallback thresholds.
            - Exposed normalization and DeTofu as instance methods using the existing native converter.

            Native Interop and Memory Safety:
            - Added P/Invoke bindings for native custom dictionary initialization, normalization, and DeTofu.
            - Implemented CustomDictionaryMarshaller with safe UTF-8 encoding and pinned managed buffers.
            - Added sequential native structure layouts with pointer-sized array counts.
            - Added deterministic cleanup of pinned dictionary buffers on success and failure.
            - Added validation for dictionary slots, modes, null entries, embedded NUL characters, and invalid UTF-16.
            - Preserved native error messages when custom dictionary initialization fails.
            - Reused existing UTF-8 marshalling and native string cleanup infrastructure.
            - Preserved native converter ownership and disposal behavior.

            Unicode and Text Processing:
            - Added native-backed standard and extended CJK compatibility normalization.
            - Added configurable DeTofu fallback for supported CJK Unicode extensions.
            - Preserved unmapped characters according to native transformation semantics.
            - Supported supplementary-plane Unicode characters in normalization and fallback operations.
            - Documented the optional Normalize -> Convert -> DeTofu processing pipeline.
            - Kept normalization and DeTofu explicitly opt-in without changing existing conversion behavior.

            Native Runtime Updates:
            - Updated all bundled native opencc_fmmseg_capi runtimes to v0.13.1.
            - Enabled native support for all 25 dictionary slots, including Small Seal Script slots.
            - Aligned bundled native libraries with the new custom dictionary and Unicode transformation APIs.

            Testing and Validation:
            - Added 32 custom dictionary regression tests covering Append, Override, validation, and native failures.
            - Added 28 additional regression tests for normalization, DeTofu, and Unicode behavior.
            - Added coverage for native error propagation, buffer cleanup, and recovery after initialization failures.
            - Added tests for supplementary Unicode characters, fallback levels, and invalid inputs.
            - Resolved ReSharper disposable lifetime warnings in custom dictionary tests.
            - Passed all 101 tests in Windows x64 Release configuration.
            - Preserved netstandard2.0 compatibility.
            - Linux, macOS, and ARM64 execution have not been independently tested locally.

            Documentation and Compatibility:
            - Expanded XML documentation for all new public APIs and enum members.
            - Added README examples for custom dictionaries, Unicode normalization, and DeTofu.
            - Updated release documentation with native version requirements and usage guidance.
            - Preserved existing constructors, conversion overloads, and public API behavior.
            - Avoided additional overhead in existing conversion hot paths.
            - Maintained backward compatibility with existing managed consumers.
title: OpenccFmmseg C API Interop Library
